name: check
doc:
check(file_or_dir)

If file_or_dir is a directory and not a symbolic link, then recursively
descend the directory tree named by file_or_dir, checking all .py files
along the way. If file_or_dir is an ordinary Python source file, it is
checked for whitespace related problems. The diagnostic messages are
written to standard output using the print statement.

name: filename_only
doc: Flag indicating whether to print only the filenames of files containing whitespace related problems. This is set to true by the -q option if called as a script.

name: NannyNag
doc:
Raised by process_tokens() if detecting an ambiguous indent.
Captured and handled in check().

name: process_tokens
doc: This function is used by check() to process tokens generated by the tokenize module.

name: verbose
doc: Flag indicating whether to print verbose messages. This is incremented by the -v option if called as a script.
